subject: Variable not found when fitting model?

messages.author: 9eb76671b91cdc41
messages.subject: Variable not found when fitting model?
parts:
Hi everyone, I am an absolute lavaan-beginner, so this may be an absolute 
beginner´s problem. 

"SEKSTRES" is not found, but as I understand it, it is there. What am I doing wrong/missing? Thank you very much!

Here is my code:

modelprobe <- 'BIS =~ ARES_1 + ARES_2 + ARES_3 + ARES_4 EmReg =~ SEKSTRES + SEKANGST + SEKPOSEM SWE =~ SWE_1 + SWE_2 + SWE_3 + SWE_4 EmReg~BIS SWE~BIS + EmReg'
> fit <- sem (modelprobe, data = data1)
Error in ~SEKSTRES + SEKANGST + SEKPOSEMSWE = ~SWE_1 + SWE_2 + SWE_3 +  : 
  object 'SEKSTRES' not found
> exists ("SEKSTRES", where = data1)
[1] TRUE

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Variable not found when fitting model?
parts:
Maybe you need to put each formula on a different line, like:

Modelprobe <- '

BIS =~ ARES_1 + ARES_2 + ARES_3 + ARES_4
EmReg =~ SEKSTRES + SEKANGST + SEKPOSEM

WE =~ SWE_1 + SWE_2 + SWE_3 + SWE_4

EmReg ~ BIS
SWE ~ BIS + EmReg
'

> modelprobe <- 'BIS =~ ARES_1 + ARES_2 + ARES_3 + ARES_4 EmReg =~
> SEKSTRES + SEKANGST + SEKPOSEM SWE =~ SWE_1 + SWE_2 + SWE_3 + SWE_4
> EmReg~BIS SWE~BIS + EmReg' > fit <- sem (modelprobe, data = data1) Error
> in ~SEKSTRES + SEKANGST + SEKPOSEMSWE = ~SWE_1 + SWE_2 + SWE_3 + :
> object 'SEKSTRES' not found > exists ("SEKSTRES", where = data1) [1] TRUE
>
